p.espaces.rg_t: ⚖️ Trade rules, from country to country
p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, production standards, starting a business, investment platforms: the official resources of any country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, opens up the official updated sources, then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and Duties when Joining the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business is Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform is not signed by a regulator before you trust your money to it · Global Voices
p.espaces.rg_note: A page opens in its own language: use your browser's translation, or "Understand a document" for a document. For a major decision, ask a professional in that area.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, sellers and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not submit customs declarations: a licensed customs agent (forwarder) can do this for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UNWTO): obligations and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (EU): Duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and obligations when entering the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: declaration of load (sea), declaration of air freight (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to receive reduced obligations)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (businesses importing or exporting to the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificates, licenses, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer takes care of everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the goods cleared for export to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: seller loads on ship; after that, risks and costs are on buyers.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays freight and insurance at port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller ships to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. such lists are rejected and may be reported.
p.espaces.cu_find: Find a carrier or a carrier
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Always check the exact rules for your production.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare payments for your country before you send.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance prices worldwide (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Multi-location cash collection, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Receiving money, bank transfers, phone wallets
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, payments show before you send
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash on hand.
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total gain: payment + exchange rate. A rate worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash on hand, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID document is often required, both for sending and for receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money for someone you only met online, or to "discover" a prize, a package, a loan or a visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices vary: always check their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, set the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers' country: no counterfeits, no unauthorised regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (the "Wholesale / Suppliers" list here or the wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: production, transportation, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payments and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the real delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trade regulations).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for customer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrencies.
p.espaces.ds_w2: And paid jobs that promise to make you rich soon.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and false ratings: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a bunch of non-EU countries pay VAT from the first euro.

p.papier.title: als_Latn
Understand a document
p.papier.sub: Take a photo of a letter, prescription, form or sign: read it in your language.
p.papier.private: The photo stays on your phone, only the text that's been read is sent to the free translation service.
p.papier.first: First time for this language: phone downloads its reading data (some MB).
p.papier.none: No text found. Take the photo again, flat and with more light.
p.papier.e_lib: Unable to start reading: first time requesting the Internet. Please try again when connected.
p.papier.e_read: Reading failed. Take the photo again.
p.papier.e_tr: Translation cannot be completed (link or daily limit). Try again.
p.papier.warn: Machine translation: for an important document (court, health, money, residence permit), check it with someone you trust or with an association. Handwriting is often not read well.
